paragraphs.title: Judge blocks Trump’s FCC from targeting ABC stations: ‘This is not a close case’

passages.title: The Thanksgiving Parade on Saturday. Can They Do That?
passages.text: Macy’s officially pressing pause on its iconic Thanksgiving Day Parade, now postponed to Saturday with a powerful storm closing in. After more than a century of tradition, the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade is suddenly flexible. With the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day parade now happening days after it was scheduled, rain or shine it is marking 100 years with what is planned to be the biggest parade in their history. With a powerful storm bearing down on New York, the parade was postponed to Saturday, by which time many of the city’s visitors planned to be elsewhere. Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day parade will be pushed back to Saturday because of severe weather, officials said.

passages.title: Steelers release Aaron Rodgers after he blasts head coach over benching
passages.text: The Pittsburgh Steelers released quarterback Aaron Rodgers after he blasted head coach Mike McCarthy over being benched. Marquez Valdes-Scantling showed support for Aaron Rodgers after the four-time MVP was released by the Pittsburgh Steelers following his remarks about Mike McCarthy. Aaron Rodgers was released by the Pittsburgh Steelers after claiming on "The Pat McAfee Show" that coach Mike McCarthy slept through team meetings. Mike McCarthy's comments from his introductory press conference with the Dallas Cowboys have resurfaced after Aaron Rodgers excoriated the Pittsburgh Steelers' head coach. Famed agent Leigh Steinberg says Aaron Rodgers' public accusations against Steelers coach Mike McCarthy could deter future free agents from Pittsburgh.
